description:
Freego X3 / X3 Pro All-Terrain Electric Dirt Bike with Pedals

The Freego X3 Pro is built for riders who want higher-output electric dirt bike performance, long-range battery options, pedal-assist versatility, and stable control on mixed terrain. With a 4500W nominal / 8000W peak rear brushless DC hub motor, a 72V lithium battery platform, and dual riding modes, this all-terrain electric dirt bike is designed for serious off-road riding, adventure use, and powerful daily exploration where permitted.

Core Performance Highlights

Motor: 4500W nominal / 8000W peak rear brushless DC hub motor.

Top speed: City Mode up to 28 MPH; Off-road Mode up to 56 MPH.

Battery options: 72V 40Ah (2880Wh) lithium battery or 72V 50Ah (3600Wh) lithium battery.

Riding range: Up to 110 miles in City Mode at 20 MPH with pedal assist; up to 40 miles in Off-road Mode at 45 MPH under listed test conditions.

Controller: Fardriver brushless motor controller, 100A nominal / 300A peak.

Why Riders Choose the Freego X3 Pro

The Freego X3 Pro combines electric dirt bike power with pedals for riders who want both throttle control and pedal-assist flexibility. City Mode limits speed for more controlled riding, while Off-road Mode unlocks up to 56 MPH for private roads, trails, and off-road environments where allowed. The LCD display, full-twist throttle, and single-speed drivetrain keep the cockpit simple and easy to manage.

Built for Suspension, Braking, and Visibility

A high-strength steel pipe frame works with high-performance hydraulic front and rear shock absorbers, an inverted front fork, and a rear KKE shock to support rough-terrain handling. Hydraulic disc brakes with 4-piston calipers and 203 mm rotors provide strong stopping power at the front and rear. The lighting system includes an LED headlight, rear brake light, and turn signals for better visibility.

Key Specifications

Model Freego X3 / X3 Pro

Motor Power 4500W nominal / 8000W peak rear brushless DC hub motor

Battery 72V 40Ah (2880Wh) lithium battery or 72V 50Ah (3600Wh) lithium battery

Controller Fardriver brushless motor controller, 100A nominal / 300A peak

Motor Activation Electric throttle with pedal-assist sensor

Throttle Full-twist throttle

Frame High-strength steel pipe

Display LCD display

Max Load 330 lb (150 kg)

Net Weight 132 lb (60 kg) including battery; battery weight 46 lb (21 kg)

Charging Time 5-8 hours

Charger 84V, 6A

Brake System Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, 4-piston calipers, 203 mm rotors

Suspension Hydraulic front and rear shock absorbers, inverted front fork, rear KKE shock

Wheels & Tires Front/rear 19 x 1.6 spoke wheels with 2.75 x 19 tubed pneumatic motorcycle-grade tires

Lighting LED headlight, rear brake light, and turn signals

Suggested Rider Height 5'7"-6'3" (170-190 cm)

Range Note

Range varies by rider weight, speed, terrain, wind, tire pressure, temperature, payload, and riding mode. The listed range is based on test conditions of a 165 lb rider, no bags, flat road, 77°F, and no wind.

FAQ

How fast can the Freego X3 Pro go?
The bike reaches up to 28 MPH in City Mode and up to 56 MPH in Off-road Mode.

What battery options are available?
The X3 / X3 Pro platform is listed with 72V 40Ah (2880Wh) and 72V 50Ah (3600Wh) lithium battery options.

Is this electric dirt bike suitable for off-road riding?
Yes. It uses full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, motorcycle-grade tires, and Off-road Mode for high-power riding where legally permitted.
